text: Yes, two ways. (1) Inside GitHub, the quick fix: today the engine publishes at most every 8-10 s and the phone polls every 5 s through GitHub's cached API, so 10-15 s lag is built in. I'll split a tiny status file (heartbeat, progress, scanning) from the big bet list, have the engine write it every ~2 s during a scan, and have the phone poll only that every 2 s (304 answers are free, ~1,800 calls/h, under the 5,000/h limit). That should get you to 2-4 s. (2) If that's still laggy, a true push (ntfy or Firebase relay) would be instant, but it sends status data outside GitHub so it's your call; I'll only ask if (1) falls short. Written as TCL80 in TASKS; the next engineer session builds it.
